نبذة

Exquisite Brows and Spa in Glebe is a haven for those seeking a comprehensive range of beauty services, from threading and waxing to rejuvenating facials and lash treatments. Each service is delivered in a soothing environment designed to enhance your comfort and relaxation. With a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, this salon ensures that every visit leaves you feeling pampered and revitalised.

  • Facials
  • Henna Tattoos
  • Massage (Ayurvedic Gentle)
  • Eyebrow Powder & Brush
  • Brow Code Nourishing oil
  • Mascara/Gel
